summary: Suspension of fine sentence under CrPC s.389; fine is independent sentence under IPC s.53, s.64; Satyendra Kumar Mehra precedent cited; respondent liable for default sentence despite partial fine payment; impugned order failing to suspend fine enforcement; substantive sentence suspension valid but fine suspension oversight corrected.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.13(1)(d), s.13(2)
Indian Penal Code s.120B, s.420, s.419
Satyendra Kumar Mehra v. State of Jharkhand
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court direction regarding fine suspension clarified; respondent to serve sentence for default in fine payment beyond Rs.15 lakhs deposited.
